J x G — THE VOLUME SIGNAL CROSSED WITH THE ZONE (ECONOMICS_SIM_PRODUCTION_REBASE.md §5.33, §5.34).
Measures only. Signals: SMA (production's window sum), median (the window's lower-middle
per-block count against the shipped baseline), median-r (the median against the baseline
restated as the median of variable traffic at the baseline's mean, 35; variable traffic
only), median+floor (the median, the stuffer paying the relay floor on its own bodies),
decoupled (the baseline in place of volume: release, the burn and C read none), rails-only
(release rails at 1.0; the burn and C still read the sum). Traffic: steady (the schedule's
demand every block) or variable (a geometric count around it drawn at the block's height:
Poisson arrivals over exponential block intervals; the pool carries what a block does not
list), at seed 1. Zone: N 2-in/2-out
spends of 19939 B (genesis depth and Standard fee) plus the coinbase reserve (1386 B), beside
the inherited and re-derived zones; w_ref at 3000 and 12595 B, each fixed across N. Not re-derived:
TX_WEIGHT_LIMIT (the sim does not read it; it caps one transaction, not a count) and
COINBASE_RESERVE (it does not depend on the zone). A ratio is the operand over the baseline
before the release rails clamp it to [0.8, 1.3].

THE HONEST CHAIN. Per signal, traffic, zone and w_ref: the ratio the chain rests at (the window
before the step), the year-1 Standard fee (SKL, and over the ceiling), a day's blocks filled to
the zone at the year-1 relay floor (SKL), the first year blocks carry the design load
(30 spends, 48 ordinary transactions a block), the declared step's up-edge (M_r over the
window before it and the trace's last window, and the blocks until that window mean covers 95 % of
the move), and for a median arm on variable traffic its count over year 1 after the window's first
fill, per seed: the mean, and the share of blocks at 34 and at 35, the derived median.

THE STUFFER. Per signal, traffic, zone, w_ref and start: a stuffer holding its share (100 = every
miner) for the whole measured span (2160 blocks from the start of the year); the bodies
listed, M_r at the span's last block, M_r and the ratio over its last window (at rest), M_r's mean
over the span, the longest run of M_r > 1.0, the stuffer's payout less its fees against no
stuffing (SKL), the break-even burn (the burn rate on its own fees, had its bodies paid the
relay floor, at which that payout is zero: its gain before the burn of its own fees over the
floor fees on its bodies, percent; over 100 % no burn of floor fees deters it; - with no
bodies), and the burn and C at the span's last block. A share is an even proportion of the
blocks; the bodies are the ordinary 1-in/2-out, the lightest valid shape (CEN-I1).
